tweets.text: A French cryptographer just published the exact Shor-attack circuits for secp256k1 that Google's quantum team computed but refused to release. 6.5-10% fewer Toffoli gates than Babbush. The blueprints are now public on arXiv.

Bitcoin is tracking a -8.7% difficulty retarget around June 12-13 — the biggest downward swing in a while. Meanwhile fees are sitting at 1 sat/vbyte. Miners are dropping off and blocks are practically free to get into.

Bitfarms' parent Keel just priced $400M in convertible notes — upsized from $350M because demand was too strong. A 25% conversion premium at $7.41/share. The Bitcoin mining infrastructure buildout is attracting real capital again.

Stacks' PoX-5 PR just rewrote how BTC bond lockups work at the consensus layer — hash-gating early exits with sha256(sha256(staker)) witnesses. 215 lines added, 117 removed. The plumbing under proof-of-transfer is getting a serious overhaul.
